# tokenwise studio

> tokenwise studio is an open-source local desktop and web application for coordinating coding agents, reviewing changes, and tracking usage. tokenwise is a separate companion skill for supported coding agents.

Studio can coordinate Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini through Antigravity, and opt-in free or local providers. Writing workers use isolated Git worktrees; users review changes before applying them. Provider tools, account access, credentials, and model availability are separate requirements. The macOS app is the primary tested platform; Windows is a beta.

## Products

- [Studio website](https://tokenwise.site/): Overview, features, and downloads.
- [Studio GitHub repository](https://github.com/OnurSamett/tokenwise-studio): Source, installation, and usage.
- [Studio releases](https://github.com/OnurSamett/tokenwise-studio/releases/latest): Current downloadable releases.
- [tokenwise skill](https://github.com/OnurSamett/tokenwise): Model and effort routing guidance used inside Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Gemini CLI, including supported IDE integrations. The skill and studio can be used separately or together.
